bench_custom_all_reduce: run the JIT custom all-reduce benchmark against NCCL, AOT, and FlashInfer backends using torchrun with multi-GPU support
bench_backend_all_reduce: bench the NCCLAllReduceBackend, AOTAllReduceBackend, or JITAllReduceBackend class over a sweep of message sizes and return latency in microseconds
bench_sweep_sizes: bench the bench_sweep function to benchmark a single backend across all message sizes from 4K to 32M bytes and return per-size elapsed times
parse_benchmark_args: parse command-line arguments for the benchmark script including dtype, warmup iterations, iteration count, and register_input flag
print_benchmark_results: print a formatted comparison table of all backend latencies and speedups over NCCL on rank 0
